newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-GUARARAPES BEGUN AS MARKET PERFORM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-GUARARAPES BEGUN AS MARKET PERFORM.

text.p: Caspian Securities said Wednesday it has begun coverage of Brazilian retailer Confeccoes Guararapes with a market performer rating and a 1998 price target of 60 reais, representing a 37 percent return.
-- Caspian analyst Esther Hiranobe said in a report that her year-end price target was based on a price-earnings ratio of 10x, which represents a four percent discount to the retail average.
-- "We believe that Guararapes is already fairly valued, despite good sales performance and improvements in the textile division," she wrote.
-- She also said the firm deserves a discount and is not a typical retailer because its textile operation accounts for 20 percent of sales.
-- Guararapes is expanding its retail division into the major Brazilian capitals and increasing effiency operating levels, she added.
-- The firm's preferred share was untraded after closing Tuesday at 7.26 reais and its common was untraded after its Tuesday close of 6.67reais in Sao Paulo.
